questions.question: A user deleted a folder on an Azure virtual machine that is backed up by Azure Backup. You must recover the folder without affecting the running virtual machine. What should you use?

options.text: File Recovery
options.why: Correct. File Recovery mounts a recovery point as drives through a script so that files can be copied back.

options.text: Restore VM with Replace existing
options.why: Replace existing overwrites the disks of the virtual machine.

options.text: Restore VM with Create new virtual machine
options.why: This creates a full virtual machine, which is more effort than needed for one folder.

options.text: Cross Region Restore
options.why: Cross Region Restore restores in the paired region and is not required here.

questions.explanation: Unmount the disks when the files are copied. The mount closes automatically after 12 hours.

questions.question: A virtual machine named VM1 is corrupted. You must restore VM1 from last night's recovery point and keep its name, network interface and IP address. Which restore option should you use?

options.text: Replace existing
options.why: Correct. Replace existing swaps the disks of the existing virtual machine and keeps its configuration.

options.text: Create new virtual machine
options.why: This creates a different virtual machine with a new name and network interface.

options.text: Restore disks
options.why: Restore disks creates disks and a template, and you must build or attach them yourself.

options.text: File Recovery
options.why: File Recovery restores individual files, not the whole virtual machine.

questions.explanation: Azure Backup takes a snapshot of the current disks before it replaces them.

questions.question: An administrator stopped backup for a virtual machine and deleted the backup data three days ago. Soft delete is enabled with default settings. What should you do to recover the backups?

options.text: Undelete the backup item, and then resume protection
options.why: Correct. Soft-deleted backup data is retained for 14 days by default and can be undeleted.

options.text: Restore the vault from the activity log
options.why: The activity log records operations but cannot restore data.

options.text: Enable Cross Region Restore
options.why: Cross Region Restore does not recover deleted backup data.

options.text: The backups cannot be recovered
options.why: Soft delete retains the data for 14 days, so it can still be recovered.

questions.explanation: After undelete, the item is in the stopped state with its recovery points, and protection can be resumed with a policy.

questions.question: You need to view Backup reports for 15 Recovery Services vaults. Which two actions should you perform? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.

options.text: Create a diagnostic setting on each vault that sends the Azure Backup log categories to a Log Analytics workspace
options.why: Correct. Backup reports read vault data from Log Analytics.

options.text: Select the Resource specific destination table in the diagnostic settings
options.why: Correct. Backup reports require resource-specific tables such as AddonAzureBackupJobs.

options.text: Enable Cross Region Restore on each vault
options.why: Cross Region Restore is unrelated to reporting.

options.text: Send the vault logs to an event hub only
options.why: Backup reports cannot read data from Event Hubs.

options.text: Install the Azure Monitor Agent on each protected virtual machine
options.why: Backup reporting data comes from the vaults, not from agents on the virtual machines.

questions.explanation: Azure Policy can deploy the diagnostic settings to all vaults. Reports are opened from Business Continuity Center or the vault Backup Reports blade.

questions.question: The operations team must receive an email whenever a backup job fails in any Recovery Services vault in a subscription. The built-in Azure Monitor alerts for Azure Backup are enabled. What should you configure to send the email?

options.text: An alert processing rule that applies an action group with the email notification to the backup alerts
options.why: Correct. Built-in backup alerts appear in Azure Monitor, and an alert processing rule can route them to an action group.

options.text: A diagnostic setting that sends the vault logs to a storage account
options.why: This archives logs but does not send notifications.

options.text: A backup policy with a shorter retention period
options.why: Retention does not affect notifications.

options.text: An activity log alert for the Create or Update Vault operation
options.why: This alert fires on vault configuration changes, not on failed backup jobs.

questions.explanation: You can also create metric alerts on the Backup Health Events metric or log search alerts on AddonAzureBackupJobs.
